name: take2-firebase-project
description: Firebase Hosting & Mobile App Setup Project

scripts.build: echo 'Build completed successfully' && npm run validate
scripts.validate: node -e "console.log('✓ Validating project structure...'); const fs = require('fs'); ['public/index.html', 'public/css/styles.css', 'public/js/app.js', 'firebase.json'].forEach(f => { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing: ' + f); }); console.log('✓ All required files present');"
